---
title: "Collective Effects"
description: "The physics roadmap for space charge, wake fields, and particle-matter interactions in OPALX."
audience: physics
status: planned
last-reviewed: "2026-10-30"
---

Collective effects couple particle motion to fields generated by the beam.
This roadmap also includes particle-matter interactions, which need not be
collective. For ordinary drift–kick–drift tracking with space charge enabled, the default
`RUN, SCFIELDUPDATE="MIDPOINT"` evaluates the self-fields after the first
half drift. `SCFIELDUPDATE="PRESTEP"` evaluates them at the starting
positions instead. Solver-frame transformations are restored before the
momentum kick and second half drift.

This chapter is intentionally marked **planned** while each implemented model
is checked against the source and its verification cases. It will be expanded
into separate, source-backed sections for:

- Electrostatic space charge and Green-function choices.
- Open and periodic boundary conditions.
- Wake fields.
- Particle-matter interactions.
- Mesh convergence and decomposition constraints.

For a worked verification example of a restricted beam-field model, see the
[Beam-Beam manufactured solution](beam-beam/index.qmd#sec-beam-beam-analytic-solution)
and that chapter's model limitations. The
[Field Solver Physics](field-solver/index.qmd) chapter documents P3M, cathode
image fields, and binned rest-frame space charge.
